name: nokk
description: Headless browser for AI agents with Chrome's fingerprint that passes Cloudflare challenges.
long_description: nokk is a headless browser engine in Rust (V8 and its own DOM) with Chrome 151's TLS, HTTP/2 and JavaScript fingerprint. It passes Cloudflare challenges without Chromium. An agent opens a page, reads its text or HTML, clicks, fills forms and runs JavaScript.

tools.name: open
tools.description: Load a page and wait until it has loaded; a Cloudflare challenge on the way is solved first.

tools.name: snapshot
tools.description: Show the page as a compact outline with numbered links, buttons and fields for click and fill.

tools.name: solve_challenge
tools.description: Solve the Cloudflare challenge on the current page.

tools.name: challenge_state
tools.description: Report whether the current page is behind a bot check.

tools.name: read_text
tools.description: Return the visible text of the page or of an element.

tools.name: read_html
tools.description: Return the HTML of the page as it is now, or of an element.

tools.name: click
tools.description: Click an element by its snapshot ref or a CSS selector.

tools.name: fill
tools.description: Type a value into a form field by its snapshot ref or a CSS selector.

tools.name: evaluate
tools.description: Run a JavaScript expression in the page and return its value.

tools.name: links
tools.description: Return the absolute addresses of all links on the page.

tools.name: reset
tools.description: Close the browser session and drop its cookies.

proxy.title: Proxy
proxy.description: Upstream proxy, e.g. socks5://host:1080 or http://user:pass@host:port. Leave empty for a direct connection.

rotate_fingerprint.title: Rotate fingerprint
rotate_fingerprint.description: Give each browsing session its own coherent fingerprint.
